cards.back:
Dirty or harmful things in the air, water or land.
Bahasa Indonesia: pencemaran
Example: Smoke from factories causes pollution in the city air.
cards.say: pollution. Smoke from factories causes pollution in the city air.

cards.back:
To change used things so they can be made into new things.
Bahasa Indonesia: mendaur ulang
Example: We recycle plastic bottles at the collection point near school.
cards.say: recycle. We recycle plastic bottles at the collection point near school.

cards.back:
To use carefully so that something is not wasted or lost.
Bahasa Indonesia: menghemat, melestarikan
Example: We must conserve water during the long dry season.
cards.say: conserve. We must conserve water during the long dry season.

cards.back:
The natural home of a plant or an animal.
Bahasa Indonesia: habitat
Example: The rainforest is the habitat of orangutans and many birds.
cards.say: habitat. The rainforest is the habitat of orangutans and many birds.

cards.back:
Likely to disappear completely because very few are left.
Bahasa Indonesia: terancam punah
Example: The Sumatran tiger is an endangered animal that needs our protection.
cards.say: endangered. The Sumatran tiger is an endangered animal that needs our protection.

cards.back:
No longer alive anywhere in the world.
Bahasa Indonesia: punah
Example: Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago, long before people.
cards.say: extinct. Dinosaurs became extinct millions of years ago, long before people.

cards.back:
The usual weather in a place over a long time.
Bahasa Indonesia: iklim
Example: Indonesia has a warm, wet climate all year round.
cards.say: climate. Indonesia has a warm, wet climate all year round.

cards.back:
A chemical used to kill insects that harm crops.
Bahasa Indonesia: pestisida
Example: The farmer sprayed pesticide on the cabbages to stop the insects.
cards.say: pesticide. The farmer sprayed pesticide on the cabbages to stop the insects.

cards.back:
Able to be used again and again without running out.
Bahasa Indonesia: terbarukan
Example: Wind and sunshine are renewable sources of clean energy for homes.
cards.say: renewable. Wind and sunshine are renewable sources of clean energy for homes.

cards.back:
A fuel such as coal or oil made from ancient living things.
Bahasa Indonesia: bahan bakar fosil
Example: Burning fossil fuel adds a lot of gas to the air.
cards.say: fossil fuel. Burning fossil fuel adds a lot of gas to the air.

cards.back:
The cutting down of large areas of trees.
Bahasa Indonesia: penggundulan hutan
Example: Deforestation leaves many animals without a place to live.
cards.say: deforestation. Deforestation leaves many animals without a place to live.

cards.back:
The slow wearing away of soil or rock by wind or water.
Bahasa Indonesia: erosi
Example: Heavy rain caused erosion on the steep hillside.
cards.say: erosion. Heavy rain caused erosion on the steep hillside.

cards.back:
A long period with very little rain.
Bahasa Indonesia: kekeringan
Example: The drought left the rice fields dry and cracked.
cards.say: drought. The drought left the rice fields dry and cracked.

cards.back:
Rotted plants and food scraps used to feed the soil.
Bahasa Indonesia: kompos
Example: We turn vegetable peelings into compost for the school garden.
cards.say: compost. We turn vegetable peelings into compost for the school garden.

cards.back:
Able to break down naturally and become part of the soil.
Bahasa Indonesia: dapat terurai secara alami
Example: Paper bags are biodegradable, but plastic ones last for years.
cards.say: biodegradable. Paper bags are biodegradable, but plastic ones last for years.

cards.back:
All the living things in a place and how they depend on each other.
Bahasa Indonesia: ekosistem
Example: A pond is a small ecosystem with fish, plants and insects.
cards.say: ecosystem. A pond is a small ecosystem with fish, plants and insects.

cards.back:
A gas or other substance that is sent out into the air.
Bahasa Indonesia: emisi
Example: Cars with electric engines produce no emission from the exhaust.
cards.say: emission. Cars with electric engines produce no emission from the exhaust.

cards.back:
A big hole in the ground where rubbish is buried.
Bahasa Indonesia: tempat pembuangan sampah
Example: Too much rubbish is sent to the landfill every day.
cards.say: landfill. Too much rubbish is sent to the landfill every day.

cards.back:
A protected area where wild animals and plants are kept safe.
Bahasa Indonesia: cagar alam
Example: Rangers look after the wildlife reserve near our village.
cards.say: reserve. Rangers look after the wildlife reserve near our village.

cards.back:
Able to continue for a long time without harming nature.
Bahasa Indonesia: berkelanjutan
Example: Planting new trees after cutting old ones is a sustainable way to farm.
cards.say: sustainable. Planting new trees after cutting old ones is a sustainable way to farm.

cards.back:
The layer of gases around the Earth.
Bahasa Indonesia: atmosfer
Example: The atmosphere protects us from the harsh heat of the Sun.
cards.say: atmosphere. The atmosphere protects us from the harsh heat of the Sun.

cards.back:
Animals and plants that live freely in nature.
Bahasa Indonesia: satwa liar
Example: We watched the wildlife by the river from a quiet hide.
cards.say: wildlife. We watched the wildlife by the river from a quiet hide.
